This page is the scope-control matrix for the three architectures. It identifies
whether each physical function is present and links to the page that owns its
assumptions, costs, losses, availability, and limitations.

## Physical Component Mapping

| Component or function | Electricity export | Centralised hydrogen | Decentralised hydrogen | Canonical owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wind turbine and generator | Included | Included | Included | [Wind Turbine](../turbine_system/wind_turbine.qmd) |
| Foundation | Included | Included | Included | [Foundation](../turbine_system/foundation.qmd) |
| Turbine active front end and DC link | Included | Included | Included | [Wind Turbine Mass and Cost](../turbine_system/wind_turbine.qmd) |
| Turbine grid-side inverter | Included | Included | Not used in the hydrogen path | [Wind Turbine Mass and Cost](../turbine_system/wind_turbine.qmd) |
| Turbine step-up transformer | Included | Included | Not used in the hydrogen path | [Wind Turbine Mass and Cost](../turbine_system/wind_turbine.qmd) |
| AC infield collection | Included | Included | Replaced by hydrogen collection | [Infield AC Cables](../electrical_infra/infield_ac_cables.qmd) |
| Central offshore platform | AC aggregation and HVDC conversion | One integrated AC aggregation and electrolysis platform | Not used | [Platform Material CAPEX](../platforms/platform_material_capex.qmd) |
| Central electrolyser transformer and rectifier | Not used | Included on the integrated platform | Not used | [Electrolyser Power Electronics](../hydrogen_production/elx_power_electronics.qmd) |
| Separate electrolyser-side DC/DC converter | Not used | Not applicable to the AC-fed central chain | Not used by assumption | [DC Integration](../hydrogen_production/dc_integration.qmd) |
| PEM stacks | Not used | Included on the integrated platform | Included at each turbine | [PEM Electrolyser Stack](../hydrogen_production/stack.qmd) |
| Water treatment and non-electrical electrolyser BOP | Not used | Included in the platform electrolyser facility | Included in each turbine-level electrolyser facility | [Balance of Plant](../hydrogen_production/balance_of_plant.qmd) |
| Hydrogen compression | Not used | Separate subsystem on the integrated platform | Separate subsystem at each turbine | [Compressor](../hydrogen_infra/compressor.qmd) |
| Hydrogen infield collection | Not used | Not required after central conversion | Included | [Hydrogen Infield Infrastructure](../hydrogen_infra/infield_infrastructure.qmd) |
| Offshore HVDC conversion | Included | Not used | Not used | [HVDC Converter Stations](../electrical_infra/hvdc_converter_stations.qmd) |
| HVDC export cable | Included | Not used | Not used | [HVDC Export Cables](../electrical_infra/hvdc_export_cables.qmd) |
| Hydrogen export pipeline | Not used | Included | Included | [Hydrogen Pipelines](../hydrogen_infra/hydrogen_pipelines.qmd) |
| Onshore HVDC conversion and grid interface | Included | Not used | Not used | [Onshore Grid Connection](../electrical_infra/onshore_grid_connection.qmd) |
| Onshore hydrogen-backbone connection | Not used | Included as the delivery interface | Included as the delivery interface | [Hydrogen Infrastructure](../hydrogen_infra/overview.qmd) |

## Delivery Boundaries

| Architecture | Project delivery point | Infrastructure beyond the boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Electricity export | Onshore electricity-grid connection | Wider electricity transmission, distribution, storage, and end use |
| Centralised hydrogen | Connection to the onshore hydrogen backbone | Hydrogen backbone, storage, distribution, reconversion, and end use |
| Decentralised hydrogen | Connection to the onshore hydrogen backbone | Hydrogen backbone, storage, distribution, reconversion, and end use |

## Installation and Common Project Scope

Installation is not a physical energy-flow component, but it remains within the
economic boundary for every included asset. The
[Offshore Installation](../offshore_installation/overview.qmd) section owns the
installation methods and assumptions for turbines, foundations, cables,
pipelines, and platforms.

Common project costs are retained where they are required to construct and
operate all three architectures. These include the shared wind-turbine,
foundation, development, and financing scopes represented elsewhere in the
model. They are common components, not out-of-boundary components.

Wider onshore network reinforcement is excluded unless a scenario explicitly
assigns it to the offshore project.

## Accounting Rule

Architecture pages determine whether a component or function is included.
Component and methodology pages determine how it is represented. A cost, loss,
availability factor, installation activity, or replacement is booked by its
canonical owner and must not be added again on an architecture page.
